notes.title: Vectronom at Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.content:
Get ready!

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

And Vectronom joins the event! 🎵
Shake your little cube to a whole bunch of music that will get you in the mood.
And enjoy a discounted price on the game and its soundtrack for the duration of the event. 🕺

notes.title: Vectronom @ SGDQ2021
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33462078/8d1277cf080f4f34e3dd767a00b644070ffa7364.png

SGDQ is live!

It's been a long-time dream of ours to see a Vectronom run at Games Done Quick and now we are happy to say it’s happening tomorrow! You’re invited to a watch party on our Discord server, where you’ll get to see inhuman feats of speed and help raise money for charity.

If you don't know about SGDQ, it's the greatest speedrun event ever. In a nutshell, it lasts 6 days and the schedule is packed with all sorts of games run by some of the world’s best speedrunners. You get to see a crazy good selection of games from different eras being twisted and manipulated in all sorts of ways just to finish in the fastest time possible. If this wasn't already good enough, the event is all for charity and donations go to Doctors Without Borders, so that is neat. 

The WR-holder in the Any% and All Pickups category, badBlackShark is going to be performing an Any% run of Vectronom on Tuesday, July 6th at around 11:30 am CEST. If things go really well, we’ll get to showcase a selection of some of the most insane levels from the community.  More info 

The event will be broadcast live on twitch.tv/gamesdonequick and you can check out the complete schedule   here  .

We will have a voice channel open during the event on our  Discord server , so feel free to drop by and join the party.

Don’t let this event speed past you!

notes.title: Stay Safe!
notes.content:
Dear community,

To finish this crazy year on a high note we wanted to do something special by adding the mythical SIDESPIKES to our Level Editor!!! 

Sidespikes A rare and ultra-useful game element that can sometimes be a guide and some others your demise. With this addition, the core Vectronom level-making toolbox is now complete, and to celebrate such a milestone we decided to fill this update with the stuff we like the most, lots of Colors and banging Music!

We received some insights from our Discord community and added some much-needed 5/4 palettes for those unconventional and polyrhythmic freaks out there.

New Color Palettes:

- Diabolic
- Yellow Snow
- Grinch
- Cliche
- Turkey
- Cozy
- Stay Safe
- 2021
- Silver Cards
- Sea
- Red Carpet

Of course, no Vectronom update would be complete without some fresh music tracks to be used exclusively in the Level Editor. 

For this update, we went experimental. We added the fastest and slowest songs in the game (170 bpm and 60bpm), we played with some seasonal cliches, brought back some Isometric Epilepsy classics, and even created a radio hit to remind us to stay safe and stay home.

The cherry on top is the debut track of our very own Herr Balint, which is now tipping his toes in the world of ethereal sound design with "Grinch" (Name not given by Balint). A track that makes Tower Crush and Arrow sound like a children's lullaby.

New Music Tracks:

- Season Cliche pt.1 - 128 bpm 4/4 - 4 Stages
- Season Cliche pt.2 - 128bpm 4/4 - 3 Stages
- Grinch ft.Herr Balint - 60bpm 4/4 - 3 Stages
- Tubing - 170 bpm 4/4 - 3 Stages
- Stay Safe - 144bpm 4/4 - 7 Stages
- Chaos_IE - 120bpm 4/4 - 3 Stages
- Original Sieve - 110bpm 4/4 - 3 Stages


_______________________________________________


This was a weird year, but better times lay ahead! In the meantime keep on playing and remember to stay safe, if you are ever feeling bored or alone, jump into our Discord community, we will receive you with a warm and socially distanced hug. 

Everyone at Ludopium wants to wish you all happy holidays and a fantastic new year. 

<3

[spoiler] ohh, yea it’s also snowing now [/spoiler]

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Pickups are here! 
Place pickups in the editor and challenge other players to collect them all. Please note that pickups, similar to Start and Exit blocks, can not be placed on individual beats. You can,  however, place as many pickups on a level as you want.

https://media.giphy.com/media/QVa6dml5eQqun5vp1O/giphy.gif


New Music! :
Juan went ahead and put a lot of additional music content in the game for you to use for your awesome level creations. Check out the full list below:
- Isometric Epilepsy (8 Stages)
- Necessary Evil (3 Stages)
- Arrival - IE (7 Stages)
- Discovery - IE (7 Stages)

https://media.giphy.com/media/w43a63RzrQ86P9FctP/giphy.gif

- Masks

- Swamp

- Candy

https://media.giphy.com/media/GRiDCZ8ckaiBEefupx/giphy.gif

notes.title: Community Level Browser Update
notes.content:
With the newest release of Vectronom 1.1.2 some big changes and improvements are coming to the community level browser.

https://media.giphy.com/media/USVatNBNZmIlBciyVe/giphy.gif

You can now:

 Like levels that impressed you
 Save your favorite levels to your own list
 Browse categories and filter levels created by other players
 Search for levels by their ID


https://media.giphy.com/media/hRBOPWa0Uw7XZn6o2q/giphy.gif

In addition to these interactions with community levels, there are some new features:


 You can now see your badges and best time for the community levels you played
 For the speed runners among you, we updated the Speedrun HUD to show you an in-game timer


https://media.giphy.com/media/kaaKwusSUOQLDjRw3y/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/du3rSXEzioLdnE228x/giphy.gif

Furthermore we fixed some small bugs and issues that our lovely community reported via our Discord.

With this update we want to make it more easy for you guys to browse community levels. We hope that this it helps you enjoy all the fabulous community levels even more. Stay tuned for news! We plan to incorporate more ideas and concepts to the level editor and the community levels in the future.

Cheers,
Utz from Ludopium

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
The Community update is live and Vectronom got a brand-new level editor! You can create levels, share them, and play each other’s stuff all within the game. It is amazing to finally share this tool with all of you.

 Draw on Music 
You can literally draw your level on individual beats of music, like rhythmic stop motion animation for tiny dance floors. You can define how long you want your loops and craft levels which melt together with the music.

https://media.giphy.com/media/YkmE1efC4YG8M2uPLU/giphy.gif

 Play Tons of Levels
If you’d rather play some ingenious levels you can do that too. Rate, levels reach out to the creators and see as new puzzle ideas develop. There is an ever-growing number of community levels which you can check out right now.

https://media.giphy.com/media/fVn3bJsvRSVed3gEg7/giphy.gif

Powerful and Simple Tools
It is really fun to doodle around with the tool. You can use a controller or a keyboard and use mighty features like a stamp which lets you copy anything you like and draw with it to make beautiful, animated patterns. 

https://media.giphy.com/media/jSVJMJ62ujvB4basxI/giphy.gif

Come by
There is an abundance of new tracks to explore in addition to all of the music from the campaign. We are also fixing bugs and adding new features all the time. Come by our Discord if you want to take part in the development and leave a review right here on Steam to help us out. 
To our Discord -> discord.gg/ludopium
Twitter -> twitter.com/ludopium
Instagram -> instagram.com/ludopium/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is here - introducing new option for Free Tempo Mode!
notes.content:
What's up?

We just released another update for Vectronom which fixes some known issues and even introduces new way to play. Have a look at the changelog below and definitely try out the Free Tempo Mode with the newly added Fixed Player Speed option.

Also don't forget to join our Discord server for more information on future updates: discord.gg/ludopium

Love,
Ludopium

[code]
Vectronom 1.0.2 Changelog

Features:
- Added the "Fixed Player Speed" mode. If enabled this mode decouples the player movement speed from the game's BPM.
- Added the name of the previous level to the level finish stats screen.
- Added Russian language support
- Added the option to remap the movement when using any external controller.

Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the BPM did not change properly in Free Tempo Mode
- Fixed an issue where it was not possible to manually set the tempo back to 100%.
- Fixed an issue where level and music would desync when using the "restart level" function or loading a level via the level select menu.
- Fixed an issue that displayed the wrong text when asked to override your savedata when starting a new game.
- Fixed an issue with the on-beat color blinking in multiplayer
- Fixed multiplayer player-to-ground color contrast ratio
- Increased Audio EQ ranges
- Several minor UI adjustments

Quality of Life:
- Added an option to go "Back to Level Select" (instead of "Back to Main Menu") when that level was loaded through level select
- Added warning messages to the "Click Mode" and "Player Input Margin" Options
- Added the option to "Continue" from the Level Select by selecting the latest level
[/code]

notes.title: Vectronom 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Vectronom has just been updated to version 1.0.1 and this marks the first update since our launch last week. It includes a couple of QoL improvements among other things. You can check out what has changed in the changelog below.

Cheers,
Ludopium

[code]
Vectronom 1.0.1 Changelog

Features:
- Added the "-noaxes" launch option which skips all axis inputs on any controllers. Useful for dancepads or alternate controllers that might send axis signals
- Added a minimal speedrunning Overlay that shows Move Leeway and BPM Scale

Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the Free Tempo Mode info would not display properly in the instruction manual
- Fixed the darkness effect in level "Witchcraft" when using accessibility colors.

Quality of Life:
- Players now automatically get removed after being idle for 3 minutes if there are more than one
- The continue button is now selected by default (before it was New Game)
- Cancel is now selected by default when starting a new game to avoid accidentally resetting your save data
- The "Exit Level" option has been removed from the pause menu because it could lead players to accidentally lose progress within a hub section.
- Re-implemented the option to restart a level
- Made the blinking on Beat-Perfect moves less subtle

UI:
- Rephrased some text in the controller assignment prompt
- Changed “disable background” to “static background”
- Made Free Tempo Mode Toggle more visible
[/code]
